variant: VbenAdminLayout with Ant Design Vue; minimal production workspace dependency closure
changes: Package manifests omit upstream development tooling. Application and build configuration are Raptor-owned. Design manifest omits the unused complete @iconify/json icon collection; Raptor uses local Ant Design controls and registers the mobile toggle icons locally, avoiding external icon requests. Includes upstream internal/tsconfig with unused manifest dependencies omitted. Tailwind theme disables automatic source discovery to exclude generated dist assets and make rebuilds deterministic; explicit package/application sources are retained.
